description: Live vehicle homepage (English). Uses teslamate-query /current APIs — each request is LIMIT 1. Charging / Drive / Parking rows return 404 when that activity is not in progress. Chinese labels can be added later via a language variable.

options.content: Times on this dashboard: **${__timezone}** (if it says `browser`, that is your computer local zone). API sends UTC (`…Z`); Grafana converts it here. Local now: **${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}**.

panels.description: Efficiency Wh/km = Energy kWh / Distance × 1000. Lower is better (~138 is this car's rated).
